definitions.explanation: Used in questions or exclamations to ask about or emphasize degree or extent.
Used with 〜ても to express 'no matter how much ~'. Indicates that the result remains the same regardless of the degree.

examples.japanese: どんなに{嬉|うれ}しかったか{言葉|ことば}にできない。
examples.english: I can't put into words how happy I was.

examples.japanese: どんなに{頑張|がんば}っても{無理|むり}だ。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, it's impossible.
examples.notes: どんなに〜ても = no matter how ~

examples.japanese: どんなに{忙|いそが}しくても{連絡|れんらく}してね。
examples.english: Contact me no matter how busy you are.

notes:
GRAMMAR: どんなに has two main uses:

1. EXCLAMATORY (how ~!):
・どんなに〜か (how ~ [it is]!)
・どんなに〜ことか (how very ~!)
・Emphasizes degree in exclamations

2. CONDITIONAL (no matter how):
・どんなに〜ても (no matter how much ~)
・どんなに〜でも (no matter how ~)
・Result is unaffected by the degree

SIMILAR WORDS:
・いくら〜ても (no matter how much - often with quantity)
・たとえ〜ても (even if)
・どれだけ (how much)
・どれほど (how much - formal)

RELATED QUESTION WORD:
・どんな (what kind of) - どんなに is the adverbial form
